hero.role: Distinguished Professor at Western Sydney University. Director of the Australia India Water Centre. Leader of the MARVI programme.
hero.bio: Thirty years of research on water and its interactions with the landscape — groundwater, irrigation, river health and urban water — built on a conviction that the people who draw from an aquifer are the ones who can manage it. MARVI turned that into method: village volunteers monitoring their own wells, and a shared record that makes a common resource visible to everyone drawing on it.
